name: agents-skills
description: Discover Agent Skills under .agents/skills (project) and ~/.agents/skills (user), expose them as slash commands, list them in prompt.context, and optionally intercept the Skill tool so names from those trees load without living under .claude/skills.

projectSkills.title: Project .agents/skills
projectSkills.description: Scan <cwd-and-ancestors>/.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md up to the git root (or filesystem root when not in a repo).

registerCommands.title: Register slash commands
registerCommands.description: For each discovered skill, $.command.register(/name) and serve the SKILL.md body on command.run.

injectCatalog.title: Inject catalog into prompt.context
injectCatalog.description: Add a short Available skills (.agents/skills) block with name + description so the model can see them without native Skill listing.

interceptSkillTool.title: Intercept Skill tool
interceptSkillTool.description: When the model calls Skill with a name we discovered and the engine would miss it, load SKILL.md ourselves and return a synthetic success instead of next().

preferClaudeSkills.title: Prefer .claude/skills on name clash
preferClaudeSkills.description: If a slash/Skill name already exists from .claude/skills or a plugin, skip registering our copy.
